result.instructions: Tools for OpenRouter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much credit have I used this month, and how much is left?"; "Which models support tool calling and cost less than $1 per million output tokens?"; "Which keys on my account are close to their spend limit?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OpenRouter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run openrouter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run openrouter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run openrouter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. openrouter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: openrouter_get_current_key
tools.title: Get the current API key
tools.description: Get the API key this connection uses: its label, spend and remaining limit, budgets, expiry, free-tier status and data regions. A good first call to check the connection. OpenRouter API: GET /key.

tools.name: openrouter_get_credits
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Get the account's total credits purchased and used. Needs a MANAGEMENT key (a normal API key gets HTTP 401 or 403). OpenRouter API: GET /credits.

tools.name: openrouter_get_activity
tools.title: Get activity by endpoint
tools.description: Get account activity grouped by endpoint for the last 30 completed UTC days: requests, tokens and spend. May need a MANAGEMENT key (HTTP 401 or 403 otherwise). OpenRouter API: GET /activity.

date.description: One UTC day, yyyy-mm-dd (default: the last 30 days).

api_key_hash.description: Only activity of this API key hash.

user_id.description: Only activity of this user id.

group_by.description: Use 'workspace' to split each row per workspace.

workspace_id.description: Scope the result to one workspace id.

tools.name: openrouter_list_keys
tools.title: List API keys
tools.description: List the API keys on the account, with usage and limits. Needs a MANAGEMENT key (a normal API key gets HTTP 401 or 403). OpenRouter API: GET /keys.

workspace_id.description: Scope the result to one workspace id.

tools.name: openrouter_get_key
tools.title: Get an API key
tools.description: Get one API key by its hash (from openrouter_list_keys): usage, limit, expiry and budgets. Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /keys/{hash}.

tools.name: openrouter_list_guardrails
tools.title: List guardrails
tools.description: List the guardrails (spend and provider rules for keys and members). Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /guardrails.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

workspace_id.description: Scope the result to one workspace id.

tools.name: openrouter_get_guardrail
tools.title: Get a guardrail
tools.description: Get one guardrail by id (from openrouter_list_guardrails). Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /guardrails/{id}.

tools.name: openrouter_get_generation
tools.title: Get generation metadata
tools.description: Get the request and usage metadata of one past generation: model, provider, tokens, cost and latency. The id comes from the response of an earlier call (x-generation-id). OpenRouter API: GET /generation?id=.

generation_id.description: The generation id, for example gen-....

tools.name: openrouter_get_generation_content
tools.title: Get stored generation content
tools.description: Get the stored prompt, completion and error text of one past generation. Only works when the account stored that content (logging on). OpenRouter API: GET /generation/content?id=.

generation_id.description: The generation id, for example gen-....

tools.name: openrouter_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the models OpenRouter offers: context length, prices per token, supported parameters and modalities. Filter with q, modalities or supported parameters. OpenRouter API: GET /models.

q.description: Search text in the model name or description.

output_modalities.description: Comma list, for example text or text,image.

supported_parameters.description: Comma list of parameters, for example tools.

sort.description: Sort order the API accepts (for example price or context).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: openrouter_list_models_for_account
tools.title: List models for this account
tools.description: List the models this API key may use, after the account's provider and privacy settings and guardrails. Text output models by default. OpenRouter API: GET /models/user.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: openrouter_count_models
tools.title: Count models
tools.description: Get the total number of models OpenRouter offers, optionally by output modality. OpenRouter API: GET /models/count.

tools.name: openrouter_get_model
tools.title: Get a model
tools.description: Get the full details of one model by its author and slug, for example openai and gpt-4o. Variant suffixes such as :free work. OpenRouter API: GET /model/{author}/{slug}.

author.description: The model author, for example openai.

slug.description: The model slug, for example gpt-4o.

tools.name: openrouter_list_model_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints of a model
tools.description: List the provider endpoints that serve one model, with each provider's price, context length, uptime and latency. OpenRouter API: GET /models/{author}/{slug}/endpoints.

author.description: The model author, for example openai.

slug.description: The model slug, for example gpt-4o.

tools.name: openrouter_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List the upstream model providers OpenRouter routes to (name, slug, data policy links). OpenRouter API: GET /providers.

tools.name: openrouter_list_embedding_models
tools.title: List embedding models
tools.description: List the embedding models OpenRouter offers with their properties. OpenRouter API: GET /embeddings/models.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with OpenRouter
prompts.description: What you can do with OpenRouter here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_connected_key_and_its_recent_spend
prompts.title: Check the connected key and its recent spend
prompts.description: Read the connected key with its spend, remaining limit and expiry. Then read the activity per endpoint for the last 30 days.

prompts.name: review_credits_and_api_keys
prompts.title: Review credits and API keys
prompts.description: Read the credits bought and used on the account. List the API keys with their usage and limits. These reads may need a management key.

prompts.name: compare_the_providers_of_one_model
prompts.title: Compare the providers of one model
prompts.description: Read one model with its context length and prices. Then list its provider endpoints with their uptime and latency.

prompts.name: find_models_that_fit_a_filter
prompts.title: Find models that fit a filter
prompts.description: Search the model catalog with filters for modalities or supported parameters. Count the models by output type.

prompts.name: look_up_one_past_generation
prompts.title: Look up one past generation
prompts.description: Read the model, provider, tokens, cost and latency of one past generation. Read its stored content when logging is on.
